## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 413 captures during January 2026. Activity was monitored through the reporting period, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available information indicates that scheduled work continued without any reported disruption beyond this routine staffing arrangement. Capture activity provides the main measure of service delivery for the month and forms the basis for the image-quality and grading review below.

## Image quality

A total of 84 captures were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 20.3 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from images that produced a grading outcome. The ungradable result remains an important quality measure for the site and should continue to be reviewed alongside routine operational activity.

## Grading

There were 107 referable results during January 2026. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This indicates that grading was generally completed within a short interval after capture. The figures provide a summary of activity, image quality and grading performance at Market Eye Clinic for the reporting month.
